name: BayPlay
summary: Guided snorkel, scuba and sea kayak tours from Portsea on the Mornington Peninsula, in Port Phillip Bay. The trips include snorkelling with weedy sea dragons, a Discover Scuba Dive for beginners and a 3 hour kayak through the Ticonderoga Bay Dolphin Sanctuary. Bayplay is also a PADI Dive Resort that runs dive courses.
standouts: Parks Victoria licensed tour operator and PADI Dive Resort
Victorian Tourism Awards winner in 2005 and 2006, and Hall of Fame award in 2007
Dive groups of four non-certified divers to one instructor, and eight certified divers to one guide

trips.title: Snorkel With Sea Dragons
trips.summary: A guided snorkel from the beach at Portsea in Port Phillip Bay, looking for weedy sea dragons, puffer fish, smooth rays and sponge life. The tour starts with a talk and a snorkelling skills demonstration, then a short walk to the beach. The site says non-swimmers can join, with a guide alongside, a buoyant wetsuit and a life ring.
highlights: Weedy sea dragons in their natural habitat
Talk and skills demonstration before you get in the water
Guide with you for the whole tour
Optional 30 minute skills session before the tour for less confident swimmers
includes: Pool noodle or PFD on request
bring: A spare change of warm dry clothes
trips.requirements: Minimum age 12; children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. Reasonable level of fitness and confidence to be in the ocean required. Minimum of 4 people for the tour to run. First-time or inexperienced snorkellers are asked to say so before arrival.
trips.checkNotes: No price is shown on the operator's pages; prices sit only in the Rezdy booking page, which was not opened, so prices is empty. Departure time not stated. The 30 minute skills session is an add-on with no price shown. The tour page says poor weather may require a reschedule with notice the day before; the Terms page says Bayplay does not cancel for rain or overcast weather but may cancel for unsafe weather or water quality. Meeting point is given only as Portsea; the Terms page puts the shop opposite Portsea Pier. The page title is 'Snorkel with Dragons' and the heading is 'Snorkel With Sea Dragons'; the heading was used.

trips.title: Kayak The Dolphin Sanctuary
trips.summary: A guided sea kayak tour of about 3 hours from Portsea, paddling through the Ticonderoga Bay Dolphin Sanctuary towards Point Nepean and back towards Sorrento. A short briefing comes first, with a stop at a secluded beach halfway. The site lists Burrunan dolphins, Australian fur seals and fairy penguins as animals you may spot.
highlights: Paddle through the Ticonderoga Bay Dolphin Sanctuary
Halfway stop at a secluded beach
Guide shares local history and marine life information
Possible sightings of Burrunan dolphins, Australian fur seals and fairy penguins
bring: Bathers, quick dry clothes or clothes you don't mind getting a little wet
A spare change of warm dry clothes
trips.requirements: Minimum age 12; children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. Reasonable fitness level required. Minimum of 4 people for the tour to run.
trips.checkNotes: No price is shown on the operator's pages; prices sit only in the Rezdy booking page, which was not opened, so prices is empty. Departure time not stated. Heading on the tour page is 'Paddle the Dolphin Sanctuary'; the title 'Kayak The Dolphin Sanctuary' comes from the Sea Kayaking page. The Terms page says animal sightings cannot be guaranteed. The tour page says poor weather may require a reschedule with notice the day before. The same Rezdy link is on the Sea Kayaking page.

trips.title: Discover Scuba Dive
trips.summary: A half day introduction to scuba diving for people with no qualification, run from Bayplay's base in Portsea. It starts with classroom theory and a shallow water skills session at the beach, then an ocean dive entered by walking in from the shore. The site lists nudibranchs, seahorses, octopus and smooth rays among what divers may see.
highlights: No certification or past experience needed
Theory, a shallow water skills session, then an ocean dive
Instructor with you every step
Four non-certified divers to each instructor
includes: All dive equipment and air fills
bring: Warm dry clothes to change into after
Completed dive medical from a doctor, if required
trips.requirements: Minimum age 13; participants aged 13 to 17 need a parent or guardian present to sign the waiver on site. Basic confidence in the water and an adequate fitness level preferred. A dive medical certificate may be required. A minimum number of participants applies. Dive and travel insurance highly recommended.
trips.checkNotes: No price is shown on the operator's pages; prices sit only in the Rezdy booking page, which was not opened, so prices is empty. Departure time not stated. The page says the tour needs a minimum number of participants but gives no number. A personalised dive for people afraid of water or claustrophobic can be arranged, with additional fees that may apply and no amount shown. The four to one instructor ratio comes from the FAQ page. Private version is listed separately under Private Tours. Age 13 or older is stated on the tour page and the FAQ.

trips.title: Guided Scuba Dive for Certified Divers
trips.summary: A guided shore dive in Port Phillip Bay for certified divers, led by a Bayplay dive guide. Guests meet at the dive store in Portsea, are fitted with gear and are briefed on the site chosen for the day's conditions. The listed favourite sites are a weedy sea dragon site, a nudibranch wall and an octopus garden, and a double dive can be arranged.

Dive site chosen on the day from the conditions
Sea dragon, nudibranch wall and octopus garden sites listed
Double dive option, one morning and one afternoon

trips.requirements: Minimum Open Water certified diver, with proof of certification shown on arrival. Minimum of 3 participants for the dive to run. Dive medical and liability forms must be completed before the dive. Dive and travel insurance highly recommended.

It covers a classroom theory review, a confidence-building skills session in shallow water and an open water dive off the Mornington Peninsula. The site says it reviews skills and does not re-teach the Open Water course.

The PADI Open Water Course page and the Dive Locations page point only at the Rezdy scuba diving catalogue (https://bayplay.rezdy.com/catalog/127647/scuba-diving), and every page carries the full catalogue link https://bayplay.rezdy.com/catalog/97596/experiences.
